column1: # Datasets of the group. One row per dataset: dataset name, dataset config,
# its settings (comma separated, as qsub -v takes them), title. Lines starting
# with # are skipped. The catalog lists every row; catalog.sh check fails
# when a row has no published collection.
# Declared facts (py/site_published.py shows them on the Datasets page):
# update_model fixed (sources never change; a new release is a new
# dataset), append (new files only), append-rewrite (new files, and the
# newest are rewritten in place for a while) or rewrite (files rewritten
# in place at any time); upstream_cadence, how often the publisher adds
# files; bytes_owner, project (COGs the project writes) or publisher;
# bytes_at, where the referenced files are. Build parameters (corpus
# source, hold-back) stay in the dataset config.
